meta.notes: Probe-backed Study C gold plans generated from weak supervision over the existing target plans file and rendered through the deterministic condition-to-plan map.

frequent_labels: anger dysregulation in emotionally unstable personality structure
autism spectrum condition with sensory overload
late-life anxiety with mild cognitive concerns

c_001.plan: Therapy: CBT or interpersonal therapy for depression. Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 50 mg daily; SSRI antidepressant (e.g., sertraline) with monitoring. Skills: behavioral activation, mood tracking, and sleep hygiene. Follow-up: suicidal ideation screening and PHQ-9 tracking. Case anchors: Problem: major depressive disorder. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 50 mg daily; penicillin allergy.

c_002.plan: Therapy: trauma-focused CBT or EMDR. Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 50 mg daily; SSRI (e.g., sertraline) with prazosin for nightmares if indicated. Skills: grounding techniques, safety planning, and emotion regulation. Follow-up: flashback frequency and sleep quality assessment. Case anchors: Problem: post-traumatic stress disorder. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 50 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_003.plan: Therapy: complicated grief treatment (CGT) or grief-focused CBT. Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 50 mg daily; antidepressant if major depressive episode co-occurs. Skills: gradual re-engagement with life, memory processing. Follow-up: prolonged grief disorder symptoms and functioning. Case anchors: Problem: complicated grief / prolonged grief. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 50 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_004.plan: Therapy: CBT with interoceptive exposure and breathing retraining. Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 100 mg daily; SSRI with consideration of short-term benzodiazepine if severe. Skills: breathing exercises, cognitive reframing of catastrophic thoughts. Follow-up: panic attack frequency and avoidance patterns. Case anchors: Problem: panic disorder. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 100 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_005.plan: Therapy: supportive therapy with focus on social skills and sensory management. Medication: Continue/monitor no standing psychotropic medication; address comorbid anxiety/depression; no specific medication for autism. Skills: sensory regulation strategies, routine building, and communication aids. Follow-up: adaptive functioning and quality of life. Case anchors: Problem: autism spectrum condition with sensory overload. Constraints/Meds: codeine allergy.

c_006.plan: Therapy: CBT with exposure hierarchy for social situations. Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 100 mg daily; SSRI (e.g., sertraline) for moderate-severe anxiety. Skills: cognitive restructuring, gradual exposure, and relaxation techniques. Follow-up: avoidance behaviors and functional impairment. Case anchors: Problem: social anxiety disorder. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 100 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_007.plan: Therapy: DBT (Dialectical Behavior Therapy) or MBT. Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 50 mg daily; address comorbid symptoms; no specific medication for BPD. Skills: distress tolerance, emotion regulation, interpersonal effectiveness. Follow-up: self-harm urges, crisis episodes, and relationship patterns. Case anchors: Problem: anger dysregulation in emotionally unstable personality structure. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 50 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_008.plan: Therapy: CBT for ADHD focusing on organizational skills. Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 50 mg daily; stimulant (e.g., methylphenidate) or non-stimulant (atomoxetine). Skills: time management, task breakdown, and environmental modifications. Follow-up: symptom tracking and medication response. Case anchors: Problem: attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 50 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_009.plan: Therapy: ERP (Exposure and Response Prevention). Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 50 mg daily; SSRI at higher doses (e.g., fluoxetine 40-60mg). Skills: response prevention strategies and uncertainty tolerance. Follow-up: OCD severity (Y-BOCS) and ritual time. Case anchors: Problem: obsessive-compulsive disorder. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 50 mg daily; penicillin allergy.

c_010.plan: Therapy: CBT or interpersonal therapy for depression. Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 50 mg daily; SSRI antidepressant (e.g., sertraline) with monitoring. Skills: behavioral activation, mood tracking, and sleep hygiene. Follow-up: suicidal ideation screening and PHQ-9 tracking. Case anchors: Problem: emotionally unstable (borderline) personality disorder. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 50 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_011.plan: Therapy: motivational interviewing and relapse prevention. Medication: Continue/monitor acamprosate 666 mg three times daily; naltrexone or acamprosate; disulfiram if appropriate. Skills: trigger identification, coping strategies, and support group attendance. Follow-up: abstinence tracking, liver function, and craving intensity. Case anchors: Problem: alcohol use disorder (early recovery). Constraints/Meds: acamprosate 666 mg three times daily; codeine allergy.

c_012.plan: Therapy: pain management program with CBT for chronic pain. Medication: Continue/monitor duloxetine 60 mg daily; antidepressant with pain benefits (e.g., duloxetine, amitriptyline). Skills: pacing, activity scheduling, and cognitive coping for pain. Follow-up: pain levels, functional status, and mood. Case anchors: Problem: chronic pain with depression. Constraints/Meds: duloxetine 60 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_013.plan: Therapy: family-based therapy (FBT) or CBT-E for eating disorders. Medication: limited role; address comorbid depression/anxiety. Skills: meal planning, body image work, and cognitive flexibility. Follow-up: weight restoration, vital signs, and electrolytes. Case anchors: Problem: anorexia nervosa (in recovery). Constraints/Meds: codeine allergy.

c_017.plan: Therapy: CBTp (CBT for psychosis) and family intervention. Medication: Continue/monitor psychosis (stable, on medication); antipsychotic medication with metabolic monitoring. Constraints/Meds: risperidone 2 mg nightly; codeine allergy.
